title: Zeus journal records v1
description: Logical (JSON) form of the records stored in the redb journal. Normative text: docs/spec/03-journal-and-commit-protocol.md. Rows of the range tables are stored in a compact binary form but MUST round-trip to these shapes.

FileId.description: Stable identity of an open file object, used to detect a replaced or swapped .zpart.

Meta.description: Single row in table meta, key "store".

audit_cursor.description: Highest durable event seq already written to the audit log (outbox cursor).

manifest_cursor.description: Highest durable event seq already reflected in provenance manifests (outbox cursor).

artifact_cursor.description: Highest durable event seq already registered in the artifact store (outbox cursor, 13 section 7.5). Absent when the artifact store is disabled; never above audit_cursor.

kill_switch.description: The kill-switch latch (07 section 8). Absent means never engaged. Written in the same transaction as the revocations and pauses it causes.

mtime_ms.description: Modification time (ms since the Unix epoch) of the data file when it was hashed. With size and file id it lets recovery skip a re-hash.

JobInternal.description: Engine-private state that is never exposed through any API.

epoch.description: Incremented on every entry to probing. Range commits carrying a different epoch are rejected (invariant I5).

data_complete.description: True once the committed ranges cover [0, total_bytes) (or EOF was reached for an unknown length).

bound_validators.description: Validators of the representation the committed ranges were fetched from.

retry_no_progress_since.description: First failed attempt since the last durable data progress; bounds consecutive retry stall time across restart.

retry_counts.description: Consecutive bounded failure counters, reset after durable transfer progress.

last_state_seq.description: Sequence of this job's newest durable created/state event, updated in the same journal transaction. Zero is a legacy row without a recorded cursor.

os_metadata.description: Only provenance attributes successfully written to the finalized file.

url_secret_stored.description: True when spec.url carries a query string that is persisted verbatim (needed to resume).

JobRecord.description: Value of table jobs, key = job id.

RangeRow.description: Row of table ranges. Key (job_id, start) ascending; value (end, epoch). Half-open [start, end).

UnitCrcRow.description: Row of table unit_crc (optional). Key (job_id, offset); value (length, crc32c). One row per commit unit, never coalesced.

IdempotencyRow.description: Row of table idempotency, key (client_id, key). client_id is the daemon API credential id; the stored outcome is returned on a replay (00 section 5.4, 05 section 12).

method.description: The method the key was used with (part of request_hash).

result.description: The stored result object (with replayed false), or absent when a non-retryable error was stored.

error.description: The stored non-retryable error, when the call failed.

job_id.description: Informational: the first job a jobs.enqueue created.

ApprovalDecisionRow.description: Private decision record keyed by approval_id in approval_decisions. Written in the same transaction as the terminal approval, grants and events; never projected to public event payloads.

ReservationRow.description: Row of table reservations, key = normalised destination path (case-folded on case-insensitive file systems). Guarantees two jobs never target one final path.

InvalidationRow.description: Row of table invalidations (append-only audit of range-set shrinkage; invariant I3).
